text: Fixed JWT authentication bug in auth.js, token was expiring too early after 1 hour, used Claude AI prompt to debug, increased JWT expiry to 7 days
Switched from OpenAI to Ollama for 100% free local AI, installed llama3.2 and nomic-embed-text models, no more API costs
Built the Lemon dashboard frontend using Node.js Express, created dark theme UI with gold accent colors matching Figma design
Fixed Cognee recall bug, SearchType argument order was wrong, query_text should come first before SearchType parameter
Integrated GitHub API to fetch real repo data, stars, description and last push date now showing on dashboard
